description: Test suite for accounting dimension features in ERPNext, including creating dimensions, testing their application in sales invoices and journal entries, and validation enforcement.

classes.name: TestAccountingDimension
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying accounting dimension functionalities in ERPNext.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by creating necessary dimensions.

methods.name: test_dimension_against_sales_invoice
methods.description: Verifies that the department dimension is correctly assigned and retrieved in sales invoice GL entries.

methods.name: test_dimension_against_journal_entry
methods.description: Checks that journal entries correctly assign and reflect department dimensions in GL entries.

methods.name: test_mandatory
methods.description: Ensures validation enforces mandatory location dimension in sales invoice items.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up by disabling the created dimensions after tests.

methods.name: create_dimension
methods.description: Creates or enables 'Department' and 'Location' accounting dimensions with default settings.
